target_customer: Restaurants and specialty food stores buying from artisan food producers, with producers as the supply side
problem: Restaurants and specialty stores had no efficient way to source artisan food from many small producers. Haywheel was a marketplace that took a commission on purchases.
business_model: Marketplace commission, reported as 10 percent of food purchased

founders.name: Daniel Barabander
founders.background_notes: YC page: software engineer and former Cravath attorney, now at Variant Fund.

founders.name: Mykel Pereira
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no other source found.

competitors.name: Sourcery
competitors.what: Marketplace connecting kitchens with local food suppliers

competitors.name: GrubMarket
competitors.what: Online farmers market and food supply marketplace
competitors.funding_then: $20 million raise reported 2016-08-04, during the Summer 2016 batch

technical_complexity.rationale: A two sided ordering marketplace is standard web engineering; the difficulty was supply onboarding and logistics.

defensibility.rationale: Producers and buyers could use any marketplace or direct orders, and the company had two founders and no network yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Later food wholesale marketplaces such as FoodByUs and Faire grew; Haywheel is listed as dead.

market_need_then: Competitors Sourcery and GrubMarket raised $2.5 million and $20 million in 2014 and 2016, showing investor demand for food supply marketplaces; the company's own demand evidence was not found.

branding.domain_note: haywheel.com; Hay Labs Inc. filed a HAYWHEEL trademark on 2016-10-21 per a trademark database

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand beyond directory listings was found.

outcome_analysis: Haywheel went through YC Summer 2016 with two founders and a small commission marketplace for artisan food, and is listed inactive or dead. No shutdown post, press or founder statement was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are recorded.
notes: Company site haywheel.com did not resolve during fetch, treated as dead. The $120K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights), likely the YC deal. Cause of inactivity is not public. The 10 percent commission comes from a search summary of a profile and is not from an opened page. Competitor entries rest on search result titles and snippets dated by their URLs, not full articles. Education not found.
